question: Should experimental Claw packages adopt YAML-frontmatter `CLAW.md` as the canonical export format now, while retaining JSON manifests as readable compatibility input?
rationale: The parser and lifecycle implementation are supported by tests and real proof, but code review cannot decide the durable package-format contract or the landing order of the open Claws stack.

options.title: Approve CLAW.md canonical export
options.body: Confirm the RFC direction, retain JSON reads, and land this branch after the grouped-lifecycle base is accepted and refreshed.

options.title: Input support only
options.body: Allow authors to supply `CLAW.md` but continue exporting the existing JSON manifest until the broader format contract is finalized.

options.title: Pause for RFC resolution
options.body: Keep the implementation draft open without landing until the harness-neutral RFC defines the canonical package format.

recommendation.title: Approve CLAW.md canonical export
recommendation.body: Confirm the RFC direction, retain JSON reads, and land this branch after the grouped-lifecycle base is accepted and refreshed.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the assigned reviewer already evaluating the concrete manifest contract and implementation behavior.
